comment: Jev-augment candidate catalog for test_affected.py. Each entry: id, covers (what the test observes AND what breaks it — descriptions drive selection recall), command (argv template; {runner}=mbx-or-cargo, {python}=sys.executable), auto_run (false => suggested only, never executed automatically). Keep ids stable; a stale catalog silently degrades recall.

candidates.covers: diffs per-fixture compile outcomes (checked/rejected + diagnostics) of ~3300 tests/omega fixtures against the pinned corpus_outcomes.txt; breaks when any fixture's compile verdict or diagnostics change, or when corpus_outcomes.txt is edited

omega --check on source/library/std/main.omg: fully compiles the bundled standard library package bodies through the package-project route; breaks when resolution, typing, checking, or package preparation changes reject or exhaust the std source surface
build declaration model: Build machine vocabulary, depend/package/root declarations; breaks when build declaration semantics change
parser unit tests: statement/expression/type parsing; breaks when grammar or parsing behavior changes
object/image writers: ELF/PE/Mach-O encoding, installation records, dynamic tags; breaks when image or codec encoding changes
ISA selection/encoding: x86_64 and aarch64 instruction selection, relocations; breaks when instruction selection or encoding changes
direct execution of run-tier canaries as real binaries on the host (the _runs observation); breaks when compiled-program runtime behavior changes
bootstrap chain hygiene and alpha-beta edge shell gates; breaks when bootstrap rungs, paths, or chain scripts change
python tools/fmt.py --check: whole-workspace rustfmt formatting; breaks when any Rust source is reformatted
mbx clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings: lint over all crates; breaks when any Rust source introduces a lint
mbx nextest run --workspace --lib: all library unit tests (~16k); breaks when any crate's behavior changes
proof kernel/admission suites: derivation checking, proof search, certificate validation; breaks when proof semantics or admission rules change
float provider/semantic tests: float operations, meaning, trapping conversions; breaks when float semantics change

release record plan: the eight RC-* gate invocations, this host's lane and command availability, and the four platform lanes dry-run; breaks when release-record tooling or the documented gate commands change
foundation crates: symbols, arenas, handles, diagnostics unit tests; breaks when foundation semantics change
repository tool unit tests under tools/tests: progress, swarm, landing helpers, catalog integrity; breaks when a tools/*.py behavior covered by its unittest changes

uncataloged_packages.compiler: its only test target is corpus_runner, the harness = false driver that the corpus_gate candidate builds and runs
uncataloged_packages.evaluation-accounting: the library declares no unit tests; affected workspace compilation checks its API consumers
uncataloged_packages.image: image-emission covers the emission surface; image's own test targets ride workspace library runs
uncataloged_packages.proof-admission: proof_suites covers the proof crate at lib scope; admission's own test targets ride workspace library runs
uncataloged_packages.symbol-resolved-trees: integration test targets have no scoped candidate; they run only under full selections
uncataloged_packages.terminal-fuel: integration test targets have no scoped candidate; they run only under full selections
